## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My fork is up to date with the main repository.
- [ ] I have created a new branch for this pull request.
- [ ] My branch is based on the latest main branch.
- [ ] New resource entries use the `- [Name](URL) - Description.` bullet format inside the appropriate category.

## Change Type

- [ ] New resource submission
- [ ] Correction to an existing resource
- [ ] Documentation or repository maintenance

## New Resource Attestations

Complete these items when submitting a new resource:

- [ ] I do not own, operate, work for, represent, or have a financial interest in this resource.
- [ ] I am not being paid or otherwise compensated to promote this resource.
- [ ] This submission is not part of automated or bulk outreach across curated repositories.
- [ ] I personally evaluated the resource and can explain its value to this collection.
- [ ] I disclosed below any AI assistance used to prepare this contribution and remain responsible for its accuracy.

## Description

Brief description of the change or issue being addressed.

## Affiliation and AI Disclosure

State "None" when there is nothing to disclose.
